name: Keyboard Layout Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: Choose an input source from the Omarchy bar, switch with a shortcut, and optionally use a clickable keyboard viewer.

barWidget.description: Shows the active input source. Open the menu to switch layouts or launch the keyboard viewer.

schema.label: Bar Appearance
schema.description: Show the layout icon, an outlined code, or plain text while the menu is closed.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Bar
schema.description: Show the full input source name beside the layout or keyboard icon.

schema.label: Show Keyboard Viewer in Menu
schema.description: Beta. Add a menu item that opens the clickable keyboard viewer.

schema.label: Keyboard Viewer Shape
schema.description: The physical keyboard the viewer draws. Auto uses JIS for Japanese, ABNT for Brazilian, ANSI for US and ISO otherwise.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Menu
